suite: FPS controller with DOM/API stubs and real simulation
limitations: No native DOM, browser input dispatch, audio, WebGL, GPU or visual-layout validation.

results.name: All controller DOM ids exist; initial scene, controls and rendering initialize
Begin captures mouse; WASD/shift move; mouse/arrows aim; C/F update stance
Mouse and Space fire real ammo; reload blocks shots until completion
Escape and pointer unlock pause; resume clears held inputs; restart rebuilds state
Settings pause safely and send wetness, haze and shadow values to renderer
Drag and tap fallback work without pointer lock; touch movement, aim and fire work
Defender-hit events update mission messages and destroyed-cover events display
Real death and win transitions display correct briefing and restart actions
FPS uses actual frame interval, while simulation remains capped for slow frames
Initialization failure presents the visible error state
